newsitem.title: USA: Vertex names Joshua Boger chairman.
newsitem.headline: Vertex names Joshua Boger chairman.

text.p: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Inc said Friday that Dr. Joshua Boger has been named chairman of the board of directors.
Boger succeeds Benno Schmidt, who retired as chairman of the board in March 1997. Boger, Vertex's founder, will continue his role as president and chief executive officer, the company said.
Vertex develops small molecule pharmaceuticals for the treatment of viral diseases, multi-drug resistance in cancer, autoimmune diseases, inflammatory diseases, and neurodegenerative diseases.
